svg.aria-label: Right now. Shipping: Ball Survivors. A survivor roguelike, live on Google Play and still getting new weapons every update. Live: Play Ludo. Ludo where every capture is a 10-second duel. Out now on Google Play. Tinkering: The Workshop. Custom 2D physics, Unity editor tools, and MCP pipelines for Unity, Unreal, Blender and FL Studio.
